books.title: It Is Spring
books.art_why: Spring flowers, worms, leaves and birds are real, photographable things today.

pages.brief: A bright round sun rising above a low green hill in the early morning, soft pink and gold light spreading across a clear sky, dew on the grass below, no people in the scene, the whole field lit by the first warm sunlight of the day.

A close view of small spring flowers opening their petals in a garden bed, yellow and white blossoms among green stems, soft soil around them, morning light falling on the petals as they unfold, no people present, just the flowers and the earth.

Several pink earthworms pushing up out of damp dark soil in a garden, their bodies curved on the surface, tiny clumps of dirt around their holes, close-up view at ground level, soft daylight, no people or tools in the picture.

Small green plants sprouting up in tidy rows from brown garden soil, two tiny leaves on each young shoot, moist earth clinging to the stems, seen close to the ground in soft spring light, with no gardener or tools shown.

Fresh green leaves opening from buds on a thin tree branch, the new leaves small and curled at the edges, bark visible along the twig, pale spring sky blurred behind, close-up view of the branch, no birds or people in the picture.

Tiny baby birds with open beaks in a twig nest, their heads stretching upward, the nest resting in a leafy branch, soft daylight on their fluffy feathers, close view of the nest only, with no adult bird or person visible.

A rabbit and a squirrel coming out from behind grasses and roots at the edge of a spring meadow, the rabbit's ears up and the squirrel paused on the grass, green shoots around them, soft daylight, no people anywhere in the scene.

pages.text: Pop, pop, pop. Spring pops out everywhere.
pages.brief: A wide spring meadow filled with opening flowers, sprouting plants, leafy branches and birds, a rabbit and a squirrel on the grass, worms on the soil, the sun shining above the hill, everything green and bright, no people in the scene.

books.title: Trucks
books.art_why: Trucks are real machines that can be photographed today.

pages.brief: A mail truck is shown carrying letters and parcels. The truck has a boxy cargo area filled with mail. No people or other objects appear. The focus is on the truck and its mail load.

A truck built for animals is shown with animals inside. The truck has an open-sided trailer or pen area holding the animals. The animals are the load the truck carries. The picture focuses only on this truck and its animal cargo.

A garbage truck is shown carrying garbage. The truck has a large container filled with trash. The garbage is the cargo the truck carries. The picture shows only the truck and its load of garbage, with no people or extra objects.

A logging truck is shown carrying logs. Long cut logs are loaded on the truck. The logs are the cargo the truck carries. The picture focuses on the truck and the logs it holds, with no people or other objects shown.

A cement truck is shown carrying cement. The truck has a large rotating drum filled with cement. The cement is the cargo the truck carries. The picture focuses only on the truck and its cement load, with no people or extra objects.

An ice cream truck is shown carrying ice cream. The truck holds ice cream in its cargo area. The ice cream is the load the truck carries. The picture focuses only on the truck and its ice cream cargo, with no people or extra objects.

A car carrier truck is shown carrying cars. Several cars are loaded on the truck. The cars are the cargo the truck carries. The picture focuses only on the truck and the cars it holds, with no people or extra objects.

A large truck is shown carrying another truck. The smaller truck is loaded on the larger truck. The carried truck is the cargo. The picture focuses only on the truck carrying a truck, with no people or extra objects.

books.title: Old and New
books.art_why: Pickup trucks, houses, bikes and teddy bears are real objects a camera can show, old and new side by side.

pages.brief: A worn old pickup truck standing outdoors, its paint faded and scratched, rust spots on the body, tyres dusty and flat-looking, parked on a plain patch of ground with nothing else around it.
A brand-new pickup truck outdoors on the same kind of plain ground, paint bright and shiny, clean tyres, straight bodywork, standing alone so a young child can see how fresh and new it looks.
An old house standing outdoors, with weathered walls, an aged roof and small windows, shown on its own so children can see the worn, long-used look of the building and its surroundings.
A new house standing outdoors, freshly built with clean walls, a neat new roof and tidy windows, shown alone so children can compare its bright, unused look with the older house.
An old bicycle standing outdoors, frame scratched and parts worn, tyres dusty, leaning on its stand on plain ground, shown by itself so children can see how used and aged it looks.
A new bicycle outdoors on plain ground, paint glossy and clean, tyres fresh, standing upright on its stand, shown alone so young children can see the bright, unused look of the bike.
An old teddy bear sitting by itself, fur worn thin and faded, a patch or two sewn on, one ear drooping, shown against a plain background so children can see how long-loved and worn it is.
A new teddy bear sitting by itself against a plain background, fur soft and fluffy, colours bright, ears upright and neat, shown alone so children can compare it with the old, worn bear.

books.title: What Has These Feet?
books.art_why: The book shows real animals and their feet, which can be photographed.

pages.text: What kind of animal has these feet?
pages.brief: A simple close view of a pair of feet in the centre of the picture, with the rest of the animal hidden, inviting a young reader to guess what kind of animal they belong to.

pages.text: A duck has these little feet.
pages.brief: A duck is shown with its little feet clearly visible, standing calmly on flat ground in a simple outdoor setting, as the answer to the question about which animal has these feet. The duck's body and feet fill the picture.

pages.text: What kind of animal has these feet?
pages.brief: A simple close view of a pair of feet in the centre of the picture, with the rest of the animal hidden, inviting a young reader to guess what kind of animal they belong to.

pages.text: An elephant has these big feet.
pages.brief: An elephant is shown with its big feet clearly visible, standing on flat ground in a simple outdoor setting, as the answer to the question about which animal has these feet. The elephant's heavy body and large feet fill the picture.

pages.text: What kind of animal has these feet?
pages.brief: A simple close view of a pair of feet in the centre of the picture, with the rest of the animal hidden, inviting a young reader to guess what kind of animal they belong to.

pages.text: A tiger has these soft feet.
pages.brief: A tiger is shown with its soft feet clearly visible, standing on flat ground in a simple outdoor setting, as the answer to the question about which animal has these feet. The tiger's body and soft feet fill the picture.

pages.text: What kind of animal has no feet?
pages.brief: A simple close view of an animal's whole body in the centre of the picture frame, with no feet visible at all, inviting a young reader to guess what kind of animal has no feet.
A shark is shown swimming in the water with its body clearly visible and no feet at all, as the answer to the question about which animal has no feet. The shark's fins and body fill the picture.

books.title: Are These His or Hers?
books.art_why: Real clothes exist and can be photographed today.

pages.text: Are these clothes his or hers?
pages.brief: A simple display of clothes for a young child is shown against a plain background, with the group of garments arranged clearly so viewers can compare them. The picture focuses only on the clothes, with no extra objects or actions beyond showing the items.

One pair of socks that are his is shown alone against a plain background, laid out clearly for a young reader to see. The socks are the only focus, with no person, no other clothing and no action beyond being displayed.

One pair of shorts that are hers is shown alone against a plain background, laid out clearly for a young reader to see. The shorts are the only focus, with no person, no other clothing and no action beyond being displayed.

A set of pajamas that are his is shown alone against a plain background, laid out clearly for a young reader to see. The pajamas are the only focus, with no person, no other clothing and no action beyond being displayed.

A shirt or group of shirts that are hers is shown against a plain background, arranged clearly for a young reader to see. The shirts are the only focus, with no person, no other clothing and no action beyond being displayed.

A jacket or group of jackets that are his is shown against a plain background, arranged clearly for a young reader to see. The jackets are the only focus, with no person, no other clothing and no action beyond being displayed.

A hat or group of hats that are hers is shown against a plain background, arranged clearly for a young reader to see. The hats are the only focus, with no person, no other clothing and no action beyond being displayed.

pages.text: They are his and hers. Are these jeans his or hers?
pages.brief: A mixed group of clothes that are his and hers is shown against a plain background, with a pair of jeans placed clearly among them. The picture focuses on the clothes and the jeans, with no person or extra action.

books.title: Rain in the Country
books.art_why: Clouds, rain, lightning, a horse, mud and a rainbow are real-world things best shown in photos.

pages.brief: In the countryside, soft grey clouds spread across the sky above open land. The clouds look heavy and quiet, gathering before rain. No rain is falling yet, and the country scene is still and calm as the clouds fill the view.

Rain falls steadily over the countryside, filling the air with thin, straight drops. Wet ground and open country are visible through the falling rain. The shower covers the scene, and everything looks damp under the quiet, continuing rainfall.

Bright lightning flashes across the dark sky over the countryside. A jagged bolt stands out against heavy clouds, lighting the country scene below. The flash is sharp, sudden and bright, filling the sky with electric light.

A horse stands in the countryside after the rain. The horse is seen clearly in the open country, with wet ground around it. It stays quiet and still, its body and head visible as part of the rainy country scene.

A puddle lies on the ground in the countryside, holding still water after the rain. The puddle reflects the sky and nearby open country. It sits on the wet ground, small and calm, as part of the rainy country scene.

Mud covers the wet ground in the countryside after the rain. The soft, dark mud lies in patches, thick and messy underfoot. It fills the low ground, showing how the rain has soaked the country soil and made everything muddy.

A rainbow arches over the countryside after the rain. Its bright colours curve across the sky above the wet country scene. The rainbow stands out clearly, a gentle sign that the shower is passing and the sky is clearing.

The Sun shines brightly over the countryside after the rain. Its warm light fills the country scene, brightening the wet ground below. The sky is clear now, and the Sun stands out as the bright center of the calm, fresh scene.

books.title: Boats
books.art_why: Real boats and cargo exist today.

pages.brief: A boat floats on the water and carries a group of people. The people are aboard the boat, riding together as it moves across the water. The picture shows the boat and the people it carries, with the boat as the main subject and the people on board.

A boat on the water carries police. Several police officers are aboard the boat, standing together as the boat carries them. The picture shows the boat and the police it carries, with the officers visible on the boat and no other cargo shown.

A boat on the water carries food. The food is loaded aboard the boat, and the boat is shown carrying it across the water. The picture shows the boat and the food it carries, with the food visible on the boat and no other cargo.

A boat on the water carries logs. The logs are loaded aboard the boat, and the boat is shown carrying the logs across the water. The picture shows the boat and the logs it carries, with the logs visible on the boat and no other cargo.

A boat on the water carries trash. The trash is loaded aboard the boat, and the boat is shown carrying the trash across the water. The picture shows the boat and the trash it carries, with the trash visible on the boat and no other cargo.

A boat on the water carries cars. The cars are loaded aboard the boat, and the boat is shown carrying the cars across the water. The picture shows the boat and the cars it carries, with the cars visible on the boat and no other cargo.

A boat on the water carries planes. The planes are loaded aboard the boat, and the boat is shown carrying the planes across the water. The picture shows the boat and the planes it carries, with the planes visible on the boat and no other cargo.

A boat on the water carries boats. The smaller boats are loaded aboard the larger boat, and the larger boat is shown carrying them across the water. The picture shows the boat and the boats it carries, with the carried boats visible on the larger boat.

books.title: Beach Fun
books.art_why: A present-day beach with children swimming, digging and flying kites is a real, photographable scene.

pages.brief: Several young children swim together in the shallow water at the beach, arms out and faces cheerful as they move through the water. Behind them the sandy shore and open sky stretch wide, and the children stay close together in the gentle water.

Children kneel on the sand at the beach and dig with their hands, scooping sand up and piling it beside them. Their heads are bent over their work, and the flat sandy beach and open sky fill the space around the small group of digging children.

A group of children run across the sandy beach, legs stretched out mid-stride and arms swinging, smiles on their faces. They race along the open sand with the water and sky behind them as they move quickly together.

Children sit together on the sand at the beach and eat, holding their food in their hands and looking at one another. They rest on the flat sand with the shore and sky around them while they share their meal in the open air.

Children play together on the sand at the beach, moving about and laughing with their arms raised. They stay close in a small group on the open sand, with the water and sky visible behind them as they enjoy their game.

pages.text: We fly kites at the beach.
pages.brief: Children stand on the sandy beach and fly kites, holding the strings in their hands and looking up. The kites lift above them in the open sky while the children watch and hold on, the beach spread out around their feet.

pages.text: We find shells at the beach.
pages.brief: Children walk along the sand at the beach and find shells, bending down and holding the shells in their open hands. They look closely at what they have picked up, with the shore and the water nearby as they search.

pages.text: We build castles at the beach.
pages.brief: Children kneel on the sand at the beach and build castles, patting and piling the sand into shapes with their hands. They work side by side on the open beach, shaping their castles carefully with the sky and shore around them.

books.title: High or Low?
books.art_why: Real-world objects such as balloons, birds, kites and cats can be photographed today.

pages.text: Are these balloons high or low?
pages.brief: A group of balloons floats in the air at different heights, with some balloons high up and others lower down. The balloons are the only things shown, and they hang above an open outdoor space.

pages.text: Are these slides high or low?
pages.brief: A playground slide stands in an outdoor play area, with its top end high and its bottom end low near the ground. The long slide is shown alone from top to bottom, making its height easy to compare.

pages.text: Are these birds high or low?
pages.brief: Several birds fly through the open sky at different heights, with some birds high above and others lower down. The birds are shown in the air, with no other animals or people anywhere nearby.

pages.text: Are these boards high or low?
pages.brief: Several flat boards are shown at different heights, with some boards placed high up and others set low down. The boards are the only objects in the picture, clearly separated so their positions can be compared.

pages.text: Are these kites high or low?
pages.brief: Several kites fly in the open sky at different heights, with some kites high above and others flying lower down. The kites are the only things shown, moving in the air with no people visible.

pages.text: Are these hoops high or low?
pages.brief: Several round hoops are shown at different heights, with some hoops placed high up and others set low down. The hoops are the only objects in the picture, spaced apart so their positions are clear.

pages.text: Are these cats high or low?
pages.brief: Several cats are shown in an outdoor space at different heights, with some cats high up and others low down. The cats are the only animals in the picture, sitting or standing quietly in place.

pages.text: Are these people high or low?
pages.brief: Several people are shown outdoors in an open setting at different heights, with some people high up and others low down. The people are the only figures in the picture, standing or sitting clearly in place.

books.title: Halloween Costumes
books.art_why: Real children in real Halloween costumes exist and can be photographed today.

pages.brief: A young child stands indoors wearing a flower costume, with big coloured petals around the head and a green stem-like body, smiling at the camera in a bright room decorated for Halloween.
A young child in a bat costume spreads wide dark wings with both arms, wearing a black hood with little pointed ears, standing in a hallway with a plain wall behind.
A child dressed as a clown poses in a bright room, with a colourful wig, a big red nose and a wide ruffled collar, holding both hands out and grinning at the camera.
A child in a superhero costume stands tall with hands on hips, wearing a cape, a mask and a bright emblem on the chest, in a living room with a sofa behind.
A child in a tiger costume crouches low on a floor, wearing an orange striped suit with a hood that has small round ears, showing a painted face and a long tail.
A child dressed as a pirate stands with one hand on a wide hat, wearing a striped shirt, an eye patch and a belt, in a room with a wooden chair nearby.
A child in a green dragon costume stands with arms out, wearing a spiky hood, a scaly-looking suit and a long tail curling behind, in a bright room with a plain wall.
A child stands facing the camera in a costume that is hard to name, shown clearly from head to toe in a bright indoor space, inviting viewers to guess what the costume is.

books.title: Things Made of Wood
books.art_why: Chairs, houses, boats and toys are real things that exist today and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A group of tall trees standing close together outdoors, their thick brown trunks and leafy green branches filling the view. Sunlight falls between the trunks onto the grass below. The trees are sturdy and calm, showing where wood comes from.

pages.text: Chairs can be made of wood.
pages.brief: A single wooden chair standing on a plain floor in a room. Its seat, legs and back are made of smooth light-brown wood, and the grain shows clearly. The chair is empty and still, shown from a slight angle so children can see the whole chair.

pages.text: Puzzles can be made of wood.
pages.brief: A wooden jigsaw puzzle lying finished on a flat table, its pieces fitting snugly together to make one picture. The pieces are pale wood with the grain visible along the edges. No hands are touching it; the puzzle rests alone on the surface.

pages.text: Houses can be made of wood.
pages.brief: A wooden house outdoors, with walls of brown timber boards and a sloping roof. A door and windows sit in the wooden front. Grass and a few small plants grow beside the house, and the sky is bright above it.

pages.text: Bridges can be made of wood.
pages.brief: A wooden bridge crossing a small stream outdoors. Its planks and railings are made of brown timber, and the bridge rests on wooden posts. Water flows underneath between grassy banks, and the bridge stretches from one side to the other.

pages.text: Boats can be made of wood.
pages.brief: A wooden boat floating on calm blue water. Its hull and seats are made of light-brown planks, and the grain of the wood is visible along the side. The boat sits alone on the water with open sky behind it.

pages.text: Fences can be made of wood.
pages.brief: A wooden fence running along the edge of a grassy garden. Upright wooden posts and horizontal rails form the fence, pale brown with visible grain. Green grass grows at its base, and open ground lies beyond the fence.

pages.text: Toys can be made of wood.
pages.brief: A small collection of wooden toys resting together on a plain floor: a wooden block, a wooden train and a wooden animal shape. All are smooth and light brown with visible grain. They sit close together with nothing else around them.

books.title: How Many Legs?
books.art_why: Real animals and their legs are shown, so photographs suit the book.

pages.brief: Many animals with legs are shown together in a simple outdoor setting. Some stand, some walk, and some rest, all clearly showing their legs as part of a group of animals that have legs around them.
These animals with two legs are shown in a simple setting. They stand and move about, each clearly showing exactly two legs. The group stays together so the two legs on every animal are easy to see.
These animals with four legs are shown in a simple setting. They stand, walk, and rest, each clearly showing four legs. The animals are grouped together so every set of four legs can be seen plainly.
These animals with six legs are shown in a simple setting. They stand and crawl, each clearly showing six legs. The group is arranged so the six legs on each animal can be seen easily.
These animals with eight legs are shown in a simple setting. They stand and move about, each clearly showing eight legs. The group is arranged so the eight legs on every animal are easy to see.
These animals with ten legs are shown in a simple setting. They stand and move about, each clearly showing ten legs. The group is arranged so the ten legs on every animal can be counted easily.
These animals with many legs are shown in a simple setting. They crawl and move about, each clearly showing many legs. The group is arranged so the many legs on every animal can be seen plainly.

pages.text: How many legs do these animals have?
pages.brief: A group of animals with different numbers of legs is shown in a simple setting. They stand and move together, each showing its own legs. The group invites a count of how many legs these animals have.

books.title: Healthy Snacks
books.art_why: Real everyday foods that exist today are best shown in real photographs.

pages.brief: A small group of whole red and green apples resting together, freshly washed and shining, one apple set slightly apart in front. The apples sit on a light wooden kitchen table in soft daylight, their smooth skins and little stems clearly visible, filling the frame with bright natural colour.

Several crisp pale-green celery sticks lying side by side, clean and freshly cut, with the ribbed stalks and leafy tops showing. They rest on a plain white plate on a kitchen counter in soft daylight, the plate filling most of the picture against a simple pale background.

A small handful of mixed nuts, almonds and walnuts and round hazelnuts, piled loosely together in a shallow wooden bowl. The bowl sits on a plain light surface in soft daylight, showing the rough brown shells and textures of the nuts close up.

A little scatter of seeds, tiny sunflower and pumpkin seeds, spilling from a small open dish onto a plain light tabletop. The seeds are shown close up in soft daylight, pale and dark shapes resting together in a loose pile.

A few blocks and slices of pale yellow cheese arranged on a plain white plate, some cut into small cubes and some in thin slices. The plate rests on a kitchen counter in soft daylight, showing the smooth surface and mild colour of the cheese.

Several bright orange carrots lying together, some whole with green leafy tops and one cut into short sticks. They rest on a plain light wooden board in soft daylight, the vivid orange roots and fresh green tops filling the picture.

A bowl of simple cereal, plain golden flakes and small round pieces, sitting on a plain table in soft daylight. The dry cereal is piled in the bowl and a little has spilled nearby, showing the light crunchy texture of the pieces close up.

A spread of the healthy snacks together on a light table: apples, celery sticks, nuts, seeds, cheese pieces, carrots and a small bowl of cereal, arranged simply in soft daylight. Each food sits in its own little dish or pile, shown clearly and close together.

books.title: What Gives Cover?
books.art_why: Real-world shelters and objects are best shown as photographs.

pages.brief: A tent gives cover: its fabric roof and walls form a simple shelter. The tent is the main subject, standing outdoors with its entrance and body visible, showing how it can cover and protect a space underneath it.

A tree gives cover: its leafy branches spread wide above the ground, creating a shaded space beneath the canopy. The tree stands as the main subject, showing how its leaves and branches can cover and protect what is under it.

A cave gives cover: a dark opening in a rocky hillside or cliff face leads into a sheltered space inside the rock. The cave mouth is the main subject, showing how its stone walls and roof can cover and protect what is within.

A log gives cover: a fallen tree trunk lies on the ground, with a hollow space or overhang beneath it. The log is the main subject, showing how its thick wood can cover and protect a small space underneath.

An umbrella gives cover: its open fabric canopy spreads wide above a central handle. The umbrella is the main subject, showing how its curved top can cover and protect whatever is beneath it from above.

A mushroom gives cover: its rounded cap rises above a stem, creating a small sheltered space underneath. The mushroom is the main subject, showing how its broad top can cover and protect what is below it.
A house gives cover: its walls and roof enclose a sheltered space inside. The house is the main subject, standing as a solid building that shows how it can cover and protect what is within its walls.
Even a leaf gives cover: a single broad leaf rests over a small space, showing how its flat surface can act as a tiny shelter. The leaf is the main subject, covering what lies beneath it.

books.title: Where Is Water?
books.art_why: Water in rivers, lakes, the ocean, the sky, pools and underground is real and can be photographed.

pages.brief: A wide outdoor view shows water in many places at once: a river flowing through land, a lake, the sea in the distance, clouds in the sky, and a swimming pool, making it clear that water is all around.
A clear photograph of a river flowing steadily between grassy banks, with moving water filling the channel from one side of the view to the other under open daylight and a few stones along the edge.

A calm lake stretches across a wide outdoor scene, with still water reaching to the far shore beneath open sky, showing a large body of water held within the land. Grass or low plants sit near the near edge.

A broad view of the ocean shows open salt water stretching to the horizon, with gentle waves rolling toward a sandy shore under a wide sky. The sea fills most of the picture, showing a huge body of water.
A view of the sky shows soft white and grey clouds carrying water high above the land, with open air around them and no ground details taking over the scene. The clouds spread across the sky.
A bright swimming pool sits outdoors, filled with clear blue water, with a smooth pool edge and open space around it, showing a place where people can swim. The water surface is calm.

A rocky underground space shows water pooling and trickling between stones deep beneath the earth, with damp rock around it and darkness beyond, making clear that water can be found under the ground. The water gathers in small hollows.

A wide outdoor scene invites the viewer to look around and find water in a puddle, a river and rain clouds, with many small water places visible across the view. The scene is open and easy to explore.

books.title: The Aquarium
books.art_why: Real aquarium animals exist today, so photographs are possible.

pages.brief: Several fish swim through the water inside a large glass aquarium tank, their fins moving as they glide forward together. The view is through the clear water of the tank, showing the fish mid-swim with their tails curved behind them.

Several rays glide through the water inside a big aquarium tank, their wide flat bodies lifting and dipping as they move. Seen through the clear water, the rays sweep past with their long tails trailing behind them.
Otters turn in the water inside an aquarium tank, twisting their long bodies around as they swim. Their wet fur looks sleek as they roll and circle through the water, tails trailing behind them.

Jellyfish float in the water of a large aquarium tank, their soft bell-shaped bodies drifting slowly upward. Their long tentacles hang down beneath them and sway in the water as the jellyfish hover and rise.

Turtles eat in the clear water of an aquarium tank, their heads reaching forward to bite at their food. Their flippers paddle slowly to hold them steady while they feed, and the other turtles drift nearby.

Seals flip through the water inside an aquarium tank, their smooth bodies arcing over and around as they swim. Seen through the glass, they roll and turn in the water with their flippers spread and their tails steering them.

Dolphins play in the water inside a big aquarium tank, racing and turning together as they swim. Their sleek bodies curve through the water as they glide past one another, back and forth across the tank.
A whale dives down through the water inside a large aquarium tank, its huge body angling deeper as it goes. The whale's tail moves behind it and the water of the tank stretches away below.

books.title: Near and Far Away
books.art_why: The book shows real animals that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A lion is shown close to the viewer, large in the foreground, with its face and body clearly visible. It stands near the front of the scene, making its near position obvious through size and detail.

A lion is shown far away in the distance, small within the wide scene. It stands in the background, with plenty of open space around it, making its far-away position clear through its small size and distant placement.

An owl is shown close to the viewer, large in the foreground, with its face and body clearly visible. It is positioned near the front of the scene, making its near position obvious through size and detail.

An owl is shown far away in the distance, small within the wide scene. It appears in the background, with plenty of open space around it, making its far-away position clear through its small size and distant placement.
A wolf is shown close to the viewer, large in the foreground, with its face and body clearly visible. It stands near the front of the scene, making its near position obvious through size and detail.

A wolf is shown far away in the distance, small within the wide scene. It stands in the background, with plenty of open space around it, making its far-away position clear through its small size and distant placement.
A deer is shown close to the viewer, large in the foreground, with its face and body clearly visible. It stands near the front of the scene, making its near position obvious through size and detail.

A deer is shown far away in the distance, small within the wide scene. It stands in the background, with plenty of open space around it, making its far-away position clear through its small size and distant placement.

books.title: Amazing Caves
books.art_why: Real caves and their features can be photographed today.

pages.brief: Inside a cave, sharp rocks jut out from the walls and floor, forming jagged edges and pointed shapes. The rocky cave interior is shown clearly, with the sharp rocks filling the scene as the main thing to look at.
Inside a cave, blue water fills part of the rocky space and becomes the main thing to look at. The cave surrounds the blue water, and the scene invites the viewer to look at the water in this cave.
Inside a cave, black bats are shown as the main thing to look at. The black bats are in the cave space, and the scene invites the viewer to look at the black bats in this cave.
Inside a cave, big crystals are shown as the main thing to look at. The big crystals are in the cave space, and the scene invites the viewer to look at the big crystals in this cave.
Inside a cave, bright worms are shown as the main thing to look at. The bright worms are in the cave space, and the scene invites the viewer to look at these bright worms in this cave.
Inside a cave, old drawings are shown as the main thing to look at. The old drawings are on the cave surface, and the scene invites the viewer to look at the old drawings in this cave.
Inside a cave, shiny fish are shown as the main thing to look at. The shiny fish are in the cave scene, and the scene invites the viewer to look at these shiny fish in this cave.
A broad view of a cave interior is shown, with rock walls, a rocky floor and open space filling the scene. The view invites the viewer to look around the cave and wonder what this cave has inside it.

books.title: Pond Life
books.art_why: Real pond plants and animals can be photographed.

pages.text: There are plants in the pond.
pages.brief: A clear photo of a pond with green plants growing in the water. The plants grow through the pond, showing pond life in the water. Only plants and pond water are shown, with no animals or people in the scene.

pages.text: There are fish in the pond.
pages.brief: A clear photo of fish in a pond. Several fish swim through the pond water, their bodies and fins visible as they move together. The fish are shown in their watery home, surrounded by pond water.

pages.text: There are snails in the pond.
pages.brief: A clear photo of snails in a pond. Small snails sit in the pond water, with their curled shells and soft bodies visible. They are shown as pond creatures living in the water, with no other animals or people in the scene.

pages.text: There are bugs in the pond.
pages.brief: A clear photo of bugs in a pond. Small insects are shown in the pond water, with their tiny bodies and legs visible as they move. The bugs are the focus of the page, living in the pond water.

pages.text: There are ducks in the pond.
pages.brief: A clear photo of ducks in a pond. Ducks float on the pond water, their bodies and bills visible as they swim. They are shown as pond animals resting and moving on the water, with the pond around them.

pages.text: There are turtles in the pond.
pages.brief: A clear photo of turtles in a pond. Turtles are shown in the pond water, with their shells and heads visible. They rest or move slowly in the water, making them part of the pond life shown on this page.

pages.text: There are beavers in the pond.
pages.brief: A clear photo of beavers in a pond. Beavers are shown in the pond water, with their furry bodies and tails visible. They are pictured as pond animals living in the water, with the pond filling the scene.

pages.text: There are boys in the pond.
pages.brief: A clear photo of boys in a pond. Several boys are shown standing in the pond water, with their clothes and bodies visible. They are the people in the pond on this page, surrounded by the water as they stand together.

books.title: Gobi Desert Animals
books.art_why: The book shows real animals that live in the Gobi Desert today, so photographs fit best.

pages.text: Many animals live in the Gobi Desert.
pages.brief: A wide, dry view of the Gobi Desert with rocky ground, low hills and a pale sky. Several different animals can be seen at a distance across the open land, showing that many animals live in this desert.

A camel stands on the dry, rocky ground of the Gobi Desert. Its humps rise above its back as it looks across the open land. Low hills and sparse desert plants are in the background under a bright sky.
An eagle flies above the Gobi Desert with its wings spread wide. Below the bird are dry rocky ground and low hills. The eagle is high in the clear sky, soaring over the open desert landscape.
A grasshopper rests on dry ground in the Gobi Desert. Its long legs are bent, and its small body sits near a few sparse plants. Rocky earth and open desert stretch around it under bright daylight.
A horse stands on the dry, open ground of the Gobi Desert. Its body is seen from the side as it looks across the land. Low hills and sparse plants are behind it under a wide sky.
A goat stands on a rocky slope in the Gobi Desert. Its small horns and sturdy body are visible as it looks over the dry land. Rocks and sparse desert plants surround it under bright sunlight.
A wolf walks across the dry ground of the Gobi Desert. Its grey body and pointed ears are visible as it moves over the rocky land. Low hills and open desert stretch behind it under a pale sky.

A lizard rests on a rock in the Gobi Desert. Its small body and tail lie against the rough stone. Dry ground and sparse desert plants are around it under bright, open sky. The lizard is still in the warm sunlight.

books.title: So Many Shops
books.art_why: Shops and the foods they sell exist in the real world today.

pages.brief: Inside a shop, many loaves of bread are displayed on shelves and in baskets: round crusty loaves, long baguettes, and sliced bread stacked neatly. The bread fills the shop and is ready to be sold.
Inside a fish shop, fresh fish lie on crushed ice in a display case: whole fish, fish fillets and shellfish arranged in rows. The shop is selling fish, with cool ice and clean counters all around.

Inside a flower shop, buckets and vases hold many flowers: bright bouquets, single stems and green leaves arranged in colorful groups. The shop sells flowers, with blossoms displayed on stands and tables.
Inside a butcher shop, cuts of meat are arranged in a glass display case: roasts, chops and sausages on clean trays. The shop sells meat, with the counter and shelves filled for customers to choose.

Inside a cheese shop, wheels, wedges and blocks of cheese fill shelves and a counter: yellow, white and orange cheeses arranged in tidy piles. The shop sells cheese, with baskets and boards displaying the pieces.

Inside a fruit shop, baskets and shelves overflow with fruit: apples, bananas, oranges, grapes and berries grouped in bright piles. The shop sells fruit, with produce displayed neatly for shoppers to see.

Inside a vegetable shop, crates and baskets hold fresh vegetables: carrots, potatoes, tomatoes, cabbages and peppers arranged in neat rows. The shop sells vegetables, with green and colorful produce filling the displays and shelves.

pages.text: So many shops sell so many things!
pages.brief: A row of different shops stands side by side, each displaying its goods: bread, fish, flowers, meat, cheese, fruit and vegetables in windows and open displays. So many shops sell so many things, all gathered together in one place.

books.title: Wind Blows
books.art_why: Wind, trees, sand, water, snow, leaves, birds, and hair are real-world things easily shown in photographs.

pages.brief: A wide outdoor view of several trees with green leaves, their branches and leaves bending and swaying as a strong wind blows through them. The sky is bright, and the trees fill the scene from the ground up.

On a sandy beach or open sandy ground, loose sand lifts and swirls upward in the wind. Small grains of sand are shown blowing up into the air, with the sandy surface below and clear space around the moving sand.

Over a body of water, the wind pushes across the surface, making ripples and small waves. The water stretches out in the scene, and the moving air is shown by the disturbed water and the gentle motion across it.

Across a snowy landscape, wind moves over the snow, lifting and drifting loose flakes. The ground is covered in white snow, and the blowing snow streams across the open scene, showing the force of the wind over the cold ground.

Dry leaves are lifted from the ground and carried away through the air by the wind. The leaves tumble and scatter across an outdoor setting, moving off with the gust and leaving the ground and air around them visible.

Birds are shown flying outdoors while a strong wind blows against them. Their wings are spread as they move through the air, facing into the wind, with open sky around them and the force of the gust pushing toward them.
A person's hair is blown and lifted by the wind. The hair streams and moves in the gust, shown in an outdoor setting, while the wind pushes through it and makes it flutter around the person's head.

A child stands outdoors feeling the wind blow into them. The wind presses against the child's clothes and face, and the child reacts to the gust, with open outdoor space around them showing the moving air.

books.title: Animals Can Move
books.art_why: Real animals doing real movements, all photographable today.

pages.brief: A single camel with a sandy brown coat walks across open desert, its long legs mid-stride and its hump rising above its back. Warm sunlight falls on the dunes behind it and on the dry ground beneath its wide feet, with nothing else in the empty landscape.

A horse gallops fast across a green grassy field, mane and tail streaming back in the wind, all four hooves stretched out in a running stride. The open meadow spreads behind it with soft hills in the distance under a bright, clear sky.

A long snake slithers over dry ground, its body curved in a smooth winding S-shape, scales catching the light. Its head lifts slightly forward as it moves, and the ground around it is bare earth with a few small stones and low grass.

A rabbit hops across a grassy patch, both back legs pushed off the ground and ears raised, its soft brown body stretched in mid-leap. Short green grass and small wildflowers surround it in a sunny garden or meadow setting.

A big white polar bear swims through cold blue water, its head and broad shoulders above the surface and front paws paddling. Chunks of pale ice float nearby and snow-covered ground shows at the edge under a grey arctic sky.

A bird flies high with both wings spread wide, feathers lifted, its body angled upward through open air. Below it stretch soft clouds and a wide expanse of sky, with the ground far away and small beneath.

A small bug crawls along a green leaf, its tiny legs gripping the surface and its body low to the leaf. Close up, the leaf's veins show clearly, with more leaves and thin stems blurred softly behind it.

The animals from the book appear together in one wide outdoor scene: a camel walking, a horse running, a snake slithering, a rabbit hopping, a polar bear swimming, a bird flying and a small bug crawling on a leaf, each shown in its own setting.

books.title: Animal Sounds
books.art_why: Real animals and people exist today, so photographs suit the book.

pages.brief: A group of dogs is shown barking, with their mouths open and their attention on the viewer. The dogs stand together in the scene, each one making a barking sound. The picture focuses on the dogs and the act of barking.

Several cats are shown meowing, with their mouths open as they make their cat sound. The cats are grouped in the picture, each one caught in the middle of a meow. The focus is on the cats and the sound they make.

A group of cows is shown mooing, with their mouths open as they make a long mooing sound. The cows stand together in the picture, each one taking part in the mooing. The focus is on the cows and their sound.

Several pigs are shown oinking, with their snouts and mouths ready as they make a pig sound. The pigs are grouped in the picture, each one caught while oinking. The focus is on the pigs and the oinking sound they make.
A group of birds is shown chirping, with their beaks open as they make small bird sounds. The birds are together in the picture, each one chirping. The focus is on the birds and the chirping sound.

Several ducks are shown quacking, with their bills open as they make a duck sound. The ducks are grouped in the picture, each one caught while quacking. The focus is on the ducks and the quacking sound they make.
A group of snakes is shown hissing, with their mouths open as they make a hissing sound. The snakes are together in the picture, each one hissing. The focus is on the snakes and the hissing sound.

Several bees are shown buzzing, with their wings in motion as they make a buzzing sound. The bees are grouped in the picture, each one buzzing. The focus is on the bees and the buzzing sound they make.
A group of lions is shown roaring, with their mouths open wide as they make a loud roar. The lions are together in the picture, each one roaring. The focus is on the lions and the roaring sound.

Several dads are shown sleeping and snoring, with their mouths open as they make a snoring sound. The dads are together in the picture, each one snoring. The focus is on the dads and the snoring sound.

books.title: Bananas Sometimes
books.art_why: Bananas are real fruit that can be photographed.

pages.brief: A bunch of ripe yellow bananas lies on a light wooden table, their curved shapes overlapping so the group looks like a pair of open hands. The peel is smooth and bright, with small brown tips. Soft daylight falls across the tabletop.

Two yellow bananas lie on a plain table, curved ends turned up and sides close together so the pair looks like a little boat. Their smooth peels glow in soft light, and a few brown speckles mark the tips.
A long, straight yellow banana lies on a plain table, its narrow shape and pointed tip making it look like a pencil. The peel is smooth and bright, with a small brown tip at one end.

Several bananas are arranged on a plain surface, their curved ends spreading outward like spider legs. The yellow peels overlap at the center, and the tips point in different directions under soft light.
A banana rests on a plain surface, curved at both ends so its shape looks like a telephone receiver. The yellow peel is smooth and bright, and the background is plain.

A row of ripe yellow bananas sits on a plain table, each one curved upward with a small smiling face marked on its peel. The faces are simple and cheerful, and soft light shines on the smooth yellow skin.

A row of ripe yellow bananas rests on a plain table, their curves turned down and simple frowning faces marked on the peels. The expressions look grumpy, and the smooth yellow skin catches soft light against a plain background.

pages.text: Bananas always look good to eat.
pages.brief: A bunch of ripe yellow bananas sits on a wooden table, bright and unblemished, with a few loose bananas beside it. The peels are smooth and golden, and soft light makes the fruit look fresh and ready to eat.
